cover_letter:
Dear Exhibitly.ai team,

I'm writing to apply for the Founding Marketer role. Your ambition to bring AI to the events industry and scale from 100 to 10,000 events is exactly the kind of challenge I'm looking for. As a digital marketer with a technical foundation in SEO, GEO, and content, I'm excited to help build the engine that drives your growth.

At Episto, I own on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site builds for client websites. I've run technical SEO/GEO audits, implemented structured data, and optimized for both traditional and AI-powered search engines. On my own project, mirook.com, I applied entity optimization and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across search platforms. These experiences have taught me to balance creative storytelling with analytical rigor—essential for owning the story and scaling inbound.

I'm AI-native, using tools like Claude daily for drafting, research, and analysis. I'm comfortable with chaos, experiment constantly, and ship quickly. I'm not afraid to push back when something gets in the way, and I take full ownership of outcomes. I'm eager to run outbound into a small, high-value market, build content loops, and triple qualified demos within six months.

I'd love to bring my skills to Exhibitly.ai and help reshape the events industry. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
